requirement.release_notes:
Bug fixing: [Jira-68883] [Tech] Fix error.log with "Undefined array keys" and "Undefined variables" for Report Module - V114
Description:
-      Auto report preset list read the report name when the related report record was missing, and read the user name when that user was not found. The displayed text stays empty in those cases.
-      Galaxy Avero item-discount rows without a matched check item are still skipped.
-      A missing TMS report properties file, such as resources_en_US.properties, now returns HTTP 404. Files that exist on disk are still served as before. Delay-in-settlement array key 1 was already guarded in an earlier fix.
Configuration / Parameter:
-      No special configuration or parameter is required.
Field Definition:
-      This case does not involve field definition.
Result / Sample:
-      Before: error.log recorded Undefined array key 1 and "citm_info", Trying to access array offset on false or null, and MissingControllerException for tms/reports/.../resources_en_US.properties.
-      After: These warnings are no longer written to the error log.

requirement.release_notes:
Bug fixing: [Jira-68071] [Tech] Fix error.log with "Undefined array keys" and "Undefined variables" for Report Module - V113
Description:
-      Preset parameter listing checked UserUser.suspended when the key was absent. A user without that flag is still shown in the normal name style.
-      Export report language index 3 was read when that language was not configured. The language URL and code stay empty.
-      Cross-outlet revenue export read export_file_setup when the interface had no export path. The shell still stops with the empty export path message.
-      Auto report sOutlets and Sun cover custom type status were already guarded in an earlier fix.
Configuration / Parameter:
-      No special configuration or parameter is required.
Field Definition:
-      This case does not involve field definition.
Result / Sample:
-      Before: error.log recorded Undefined array key "suspended", "sOutlets", 3, "export_file_setup" and the Sun cover custom type status keys, plus Trying to access array offset on null.
-      After: These warnings are no longer written to the error log.

requirement.release_notes:
Bug fixing: [Jira-66028] [Tech] Fix error.log with "Undefined array keys" and "Undefined variables" for Report Module - V111
Description:
-      Report content, auto report naming, Sun cover custom type, and general sales FTP setup read array keys and variables that are not always present. Missing values still follow the previous empty result: no page-overflow parameter, edit link not taken, HTML content disposition unchanged, shop code left blank, custom type status F, and FTP type left empty.
-      Opening a report with a null config and the CTM SMS start time were already guarded in earlier fixes.
Configuration / Parameter:
-      No special configuration or parameter is required.
Field Definition:
-      This case does not involve field definition.
Result / Sample:
-      Before: error.log recorded Undefined variable $outputFileFormat, $editId, $errorKey and $startTime, Undefined array key toFormatParameters, 0, sShops, sOutlets, OutShop, custom type status, type, passive_mode, debug and MsgInterface, and Trying to access array offset on null.
-      After: These warnings are no longer written to the error log.
